newsitem.title: FRANCE: Council of Europe assembly backs Aromanian culture.
newsitem.headline: Council of Europe assembly backs Aromanian culture.

text.p: The Council of Europe's Parliamentary Assembly urged Balkan states on Tuesday to take steps to protect and promote the language and culture of their region's Aromanian minority.
An assembly report said an estimated 500,000 to 1.5 million Aromanians lived in the region, spread primarily across Albania, Bulgaria, Greece and Macedonia.
They trace their origins to a Romanian colonisation of the Balkans three centuries ago, said the report presented by Socialist deputy Lluis-Maria de Puig of Spain and later approved by the assembly.
Recognising the group's cultural rights would not threaten the stability of the already fragile region, Puig said.
"The Aromanians have made no demands of a political nature, asking only for help in safeguarding their language and their culture," he said.
